# KafkaConsumerLagGrowing

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | consumer | [kafka-lag](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-lag/) | 15m / 2m |

**Summary:** Consumer group <group_id> falls behind on <topic_name>

The lag of group <group_id> on topic <topic_name> keeps growing and the group is more than 2 minutes behind. The consumers are slower than the producers: scale out (up to the partition count), speed up processing, or look for a hot partition.

## Impact

The application processes data later and later; with retention, unconsumed data may be deleted before it is read (data loss for the consumer).

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Consumer Groups & Lag: consume vs produce rate, lag per partition (one hot partition or all?).
2. Members per group: did instances disappear? Group state: is it rebalancing all the time?
3. Lab: Kafka Lab · Service & Client Runtime → processing time, retries, paused consumers.

## Mitigation

- Scale the consumer out (up to the number of partitions) or speed up processing (batching, DB indexes).
- Hot partition: fix the key distribution or the slow message.

## Expression

```promql
(kafka:consumer_group_topic_lag:deriv10m > 0) and on (kafka_cluster, group_id, topic_name) (kafka:consumer_group_topic_time_behind:seconds > 120)
```
